labels.caption: Redundancy under correlated reclaims on config seeds 301--304: cost over the all-fallback cost (overflow accounting), the median over the config seeds with min--max bars. (a) The short-notice menu (notice 0, 1 or 2 min) and (b) the long-notice menu (notice 60, 120 or 240 min) at $\mu=\tilde{\beta}$, against the correlation of reclaims: the trace lender (Trace); a reclaim at a lender is repeated at each other lender of its group, independently with probability $p_{\mathrm{sh}}$ (0.25 to 1); one group of all lenders at $p_{\mathrm{sh}}=1$ (All). (c) The trace lender with the short-notice menu against $\mu/\tilde{\beta}$ (SpotHedge-style at $\mu=\tilde{\beta}$ only). SpotHedge-style keeps $N_{\mathrm{Extra}}$ spare replicas per pool. Sublet costs less than both Greedy, back-off and RetroRenting-style in every config seed in 7 of 13 cells, and less than each baseline of the cell in 7.
